pilot_password_requirement: The owner must supply config/pilot_password for the existing admin account. This handoff never generates or changes it.
source_snapshot_fingerprint_scope: Logical per-table row-count/row-value digests of the consistent SQLite backup snapshot, before operational path rewriting. Physical WAL/page churn is intentionally excluded.

source_consistency.cutover_freshness_gate: check_freshness.py compares the current source logical fingerprint, memory table versions and referenced files to this snapshot. Any change refuses the transaction.
source_consistency.note: The backup API produced a consistent point-in-time snapshot. A live source may commit after the snapshot; that is expected and is detected by the cutover freshness gate, which requires a refresh rather than implying later writes are included.

source_readonly_checks: SQLite source opened with URI mode=ro for backup and admin-hash read
no write connection to the source data directory
source hash/stat compared before and after the copy
target operational paths checked for remaining source references
